metadata.title: Positive sectional curvature on the Kervaire nine-sphere
metadata.abstract: Using the compatible-disk theorem of Deng, Hu, and Zhang, we obtain positive sectional curvature on the Kervaire nine-sphere. We construct a smooth conjugation-equivariant attaching map whose twist is exactly a Milnor--Munkres commutator. Its stabilized clutching data identify the resulting sphere with the boundary of the plumbing of two tangent disk bundles over the five-sphere. We describe the marked quotient metrics and give a positive lower bound in terms of the curvature norms of a fixed connection. The real Dirac index excludes even nonnegative sectional curvature on four of the eight smooth nine-sphere types. The construction covers the standard and Kervaire types; the remaining two index-zero types admit positive scalar curvature, but their positive-sectional-curvature existence is not decided here.

analysis.progressType: Kervaire 九维球的正截曲率
analysis.workSummary: 显式构造 R⊕H² 上的 S³ conjugation-equivariant 映射 β，使双 disk twist 在 stereographic 坐标中恰为 Milnor–Munkres commutator；稳定 clutching 识别其同伦球为两个 S⁵ 切 disk bundle plumbing 的 Kervaire 九维边界。对这一特定附着模型调用 compatible-disk 曲率定理，得到正截曲率；Dirac 指标另排除四个光滑类型的非负截曲率。
analysis.breakthrough: 构造标准型之外的正截曲率九维同伦球。
analysis.limitations: 曲率结论是 Deng–Hu–Zhang 近期定理的应用，不是独立重证其估计；光滑拓扑识别与曲率输入分开。标准与 Kervaire 型之外，另两个 index-zero 型的正截曲率存在性本文未定。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 用于探索性计算、讨论可能的证明方向及编辑润色；全部输出经作者核验。
